key.name: language-area-enabled
key.description: Keep the language (input source) indicator in its own area, always at the left of the tray icons

key.name: tray-icon-spacing
key.description: Space the tray icons, the language area and the fold button keep on their left and right side in pixel, 0 packs them together without any space

key.name: tray-pos
key.description: Set where the Icon tray should appear in Gnome tray

key.name: tray-order
key.description: Set where the Icon tray should appear among other trays

key.name: hidden-icons
key.description: Indicators that are collected in the floating panel next to the panel bar, instead of the tray area

key.name: icon-order
key.description: Order the tray icons are shown in, as indicator ids: the icons of the tray area first, then the ones of the hidden icons panel

key.name: known-icons
key.description: Tray icons seen by the extension, as (id, name) pairs

key.name: custom-icons
key.description: Replace any icons with custom icons from themes
